hints.title: Alphabet Cardinality
hints.text: Since there are only 26 English letters, any target length greater than 26 must contain duplicate characters by the pigeonhole principle.

hints.title: Sliding Substring Window
hints.text: Maintain frequency counts in a fixed-size window of length k as the right edge advances and the left edge leaves.

hints.title: Distinct Character Count
hints.text: When the number of unique characters in the window reaches exactly k, increment the valid window tally.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rescanning all k characters from scratch at each position takes O(N * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A sliding character count map with O(1) transitions runs in linear time with at most 26 entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the pigeonhole early exit (k > 26) and write a standard fixed-size sliding window.
complexity.notes: Constant auxiliary space bounded by alphabet size 26.
